Definition
[Weak solution of the Euler--Lagrange equation] 1. ch8:8.2.3-def-1\group Existence of Minimizers We say $u \in \mathcal{A}$ is a weak solution of the boundary-value problem (37) for the Euler--Lagrange equation provided \[ \int _U \sum _{i=1}^n L_{p_i}(Du,u,x) v_{x_i} + L_z(Du,u,x) v \, dx = 0 \] for all $v \in W_0^{1,q}(U)$.
